scope_note: Agent review on 2026-10-16 inspected current main and recent batches, structure, task/claim contract, profile/source/media and receipt schemas, sparse two-source rust profile, tests and CI. Unlinked, symptom-only or unresolved best-match samples retain human-review flags; agent review is not human or laboratory confirmation.
